reason: A common root alpha of (-q^d;q^d)_k and M_n would satisfy alpha^{dj}=-1 for some j, while every root of M_n is an n-th root of unity. Since n is odd, (alpha^{dj})^n=-1 contradicts (alpha^n)^{dj}=1. Hence the denominator is coprime to M_n and therefore invertible in the localization. The remaining factors of each A_{d,r,n,k}(q), and also R_{d,r,n}(q), are Laurent polynomials, so every A_{d,r,n,k}(q), their finite sum S_{d,r,n}(q), and R_{d,r,n}(q) lie in Loc_{M_n}.
